candidates.description:
When it comes to exclusivity deals with corporates, just say no, says George Bilkis. "Many startups are tempted because it's a matter of survival sometimes, but actually, it can kill them." 
 The post  Beware ‘pilots to nowhere’: Aleph Eins Capital on avoiding corporate agtech traps  appeared first on  AgFunderNews .
candidates.headline: Beware ‘pilots to nowhere’: Aleph Eins Capital on avoiding corporate agtech traps

companies.AIPath: BLOCK71 Silicon Valley-resident SaaS startup building a prescriptive-AI decision engine for product and go-to-market teams (AI customer-journey mapping, evidence-based feature prioritization, digital-twin simulations). Generic AI brand — drop items about unrelated AI-pathology / AI-routing tools.
companies.Addlly AI: BLOCK71 Singapore-resident GenAI content-marketing startup (co-founders Tina Chopra (CEO) and Ronie Ganguly) operating a 'zero-prompt' AI content-creation suite — 1-Click Blog Writer, AI Social Media Post Generator, multi-language Asian-market support; ASEAN Digital Awards 2025 Silver. Drop generic AI-marketing-tools coverage unless it names Addlly.
companies.Ailytics: NUS GRIP-incubated Singapore deep-tech startup. Drop unrelated companies sharing the same name.
companies.Aleph: NUS GRIP-incubated Singapore deep-tech enterprise-software startup (founders Suwira Teo (CEO), Sushant Garud (CTO, NUS Chemical Engineering PhD / Cambridge CARES), Iftekhar Karimi; launched 2023) building Aleph AI Co-Pilot™ — a digital-twin + AI process-optimisation platform for chemical / pharmaceutical / process manufacturing (claims up to 40% yield/efficiency uplift). Strategic partners include Siemens, Pfizer, Godrej Industries; IMDA Open Innovation Platform + A*STAR-backed. Distinct from Aleph Alpha (German AI), Aleph (US software company), or any other unrelated company sharing the name.
companies.BEEX: NUS GRIP-incubated Singapore autonomous-systems startup. Drop unrelated companies sharing the same name.
companies.Belli AI: BLOCK71 Singapore-resident air-cargo software startup (founders ex-McKinsey, SpaceX, Boeing, Booking.com, AirAsia) digitising end-to-end airline cargo operations. Drop unrelated namesakes (Italian food brand, maternal-health apps named Belly/Bella) unless the article explicitly references the Singapore air-cargo Belli AI.
companies.Carousell: Singapore-headquartered online classifieds and consumer marketplace platform; the group also operates OneShift, Mudah, and Cho Tot.
companies.Doinn APAC: BLOCK71 Singapore-resident APAC arm of Doinn — an online marketplace connecting hosts / property-managers with cleaning, laundry and linen services. Drop unrelated 'Doinn' brand mentions unless the article explicitly references this BLOCK71 SG-listed APAC entity.
companies.EcoMatcher: BLOCK71 Bandung-listed Hong Kong-headquartered B-Corp (founded 2016 by Bas Fransen) operating a blockchain-tracked tree-planting / forest-management platform — TreeCorder data-capture app, TreeManager cloud system, Verra/Gold Standard carbon-certified TREES+ projects (partnership with VNV Advisory). Corporate customers include Grab and Procter & Gamble; ~50,000 customers globally. Drop generic 'eco' / matching-engine mentions.
companies.FizzDragon: BLOCK71 Singapore-resident startup. Limited public-English information beyond the directory listing — drop unrelated 'FizzDragon' brand mentions unless the article explicitly references this BLOCK71 SG entity.
companies.Horizon Quantum Computing: Singapore-based privately-held quantum computing software startup. Distinct from any publicly-traded company sharing a similar name (NASDAQ:HQ ticker, Horizon Quantum Holdings, earnings releases, ticker-aggregator coverage from Zacks/TipRanks/MarketBeat/etc. must be excluded).
companies.Idle Logic: BLOCK71 Singapore-resident startup. Limited public-English information beyond the directory listing — drop unrelated 'Idle Logic' brand mentions unless the article explicitly references this BLOCK71 SG entity.
companies.ManPack: BLOCK71 Singapore-resident startup. Limited public-English information beyond the directory listing — drop unrelated 'Manpack' (mens-grooming subscription) brand mentions unless the article explicitly references this BLOCK71 SG entity.
companies.Mycotech: BLOCK71 Bandung-resident Indonesian biomaterials startup (founded 2015 by Adi Reza Nugroho and four co-founders, ITB-linked) using mycelium as a bio-adhesive to convert agricultural waste (cassava starch, corn bark, bagasse) into BIOBO interior boards and Mylea mycelium-leather for fashion and footwear. B-Corp since 2019. Solar Impulse Efficient Solution. Drop generic 'mycelium' / mushroom-cultivation articles unless they name MYCL.
companies.Patsnap: Singapore-headquartered IP intelligence and innovation analytics SaaS company.
companies.Peris.ai: BLOCK71 Singapore-resident cybersecurity-AI startup (peris.ai) building an agentic-AI security operations centre (AI-SOC) platform that cuts detection and response times for security teams; Google for Startups Accelerator Southeast Asia alumnus. Drop unrelated 'peris' brand mentions unless the article explicitly references this BLOCK71 SG entity.
companies.Pinhome: BLOCK71 Bandung-listed Indonesian end-to-end proptech (founded January 2020 by ex-Gojek execs Dayu Dara Permata and Ahmed Aljunied): home search, transactions, conventional + sharia mortgage and refinancing, plus PinHome Home Service for cleaning, car wash and home maintenance. 1M+ housing inventories, 20+ banking partners. Generic 'pin home' wording — drop unrelated Pinterest / home-decor mentions.
companies.Qapita: BLOCK71 Silicon Valley-listed Singapore-headquartered equity-management platform (cap-table, ESOP administration, secondary-share workflows) founded 2019 by Ravi Ravulaparthi (CEO), Lakshman Gupta (COO) and Vamsee Mohan (CTO); serves ~2,700 SEA/India companies. Carta challenger now powering Schwab Private Issuer Equity Services in the US. Drop unrelated Qatar/Q-brands.
companies.Skuling: BLOCK71 Yogyakarta-resident Indonesian edutech startup building a gamified web learning platform — leaderboards, social discussion, performance analytics — targeting Indonesian primary/secondary education accessibility and engagement gaps. ~110,000 users across 502 of 514 Indonesian cities. Founded by Yudha Pratama Situmorang (Boston University Questrom MBA'24); 2024 Poets & Quants Most Disruptive MBA Startup. Drop generic 'schooling' / education-tech mentions.
companies.StaffAny: BLOCK71 Jakarta-listed Singapore HR-tech startup (founded by four NUS alumni) running a workforce-management app for hourly workers in F&B / retail — drag-and-drop rostering, time tracking, availability, payroll/accounting integration. ~100K+ shifts and ~700K hours tracked at the S$1M seed milestone; lead investor FreakOut Holdings; angels include ex-Zopim founders Lim Qing Ru, Kwok Yang Bin and Royston Tay plus Kenji Niwa.
companies.Stratificare: BLOCK71 Social Impact Hub-resident Singapore predictive medical-diagnostics startup (launched 2015, CEO Anthony Chua) building in-vitro diagnostic tests — flagship predictive test for life-threatening severe Dengue complications, plus pipeline for liver-cancer internal-radiation-therapy response and other oncology indications. Drop generic 'patient stratification' / clinical-trial-stratification industry copy.
companies.Venambak: BLOCK71 Jakarta-resident Indonesian startup. Limited public-English information beyond the directory listing — drop unrelated brand mentions unless the article explicitly references this BLOCK71 Jakarta entity.
